title: Implement arbitrary-constellation mapper
description:
Implement the correctness-first mapper for validated user-defined constellations so arbitrary bit labels can be turned into symbol streams through the shared modem API.

## Success Criteria

- [ ] Validated arbitrary constellations can map input bits to the correct output symbols.
- [ ] Bit ordering and symbol ordering are explicit and consistent across batches.
- [ ] The implementation is simple and trustworthy enough to serve as a reference path.

## Notes

This is the first implementation task under the arbitrary-constellation reference story.
